name: Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of internet value-added services in China and internationally. The company offers short drama and AI short drama platform, AI music, AI games, AISuperAgent, and AI social networking products. It is also involved in the artificial intelligence technology development, music social platform and online game operation, investment management, and browser advertising businesses. The company was formerly known as Beijing Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd. in June 2021. Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
